description: This file defines an abstract base class for Drupal views pager plugins, including methods for pagination control, configuration, and rendering.

classes.name: PagerPluginBase
classes.description: An abstract base class for Drupal views pager plugins, providing core pagination functionality and configuration methods.

methods.name: getItemsPerPage
methods.description: Returns the number of items per page for the pager.

methods.name: setItemsPerPage
methods.description: Sets the number of items per page for the pager.

methods.name: getOffset
methods.description: Returns the number of items to skip (offset) for pagination.

methods.name: setOffset
methods.description: Sets the offset for pagination.

methods.name: getHeadingLevel
methods.description: Returns the heading level used for the pager display.

methods.name: setHeadingLevel
methods.description: Sets the heading level for the pager.

methods.name: getCurrentPage
methods.description: Returns the current page number.

methods.name: setCurrentPage
methods.description: Sets the current page number.

methods.name: getTotalItems
methods.description: Returns the total number of items.

methods.name: getPagerId
methods.description: Returns the pager ID if set.

methods.name: validateOptionsForm
methods.description: Default method for validating options form.

methods.name: submitOptionsForm
methods.description: Default method for submitting options form.

methods.name: summaryTitle
methods.description: Returns a string title for the pager.

methods.name: usePager
methods.description: Indicates if this plugin uses a pager.

methods.name: useCountQuery
methods.description: Indicates if the pager needs a count query.

methods.name: executeCountQuery
methods.description: Executes the count query and updates total items.

methods.name: updatePageInfo
methods.description: Updates pager information after query execution.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Modifies the query for paging.

methods.name: preExecute
methods.description: Actions before query execution.

methods.name: postExecute
methods.description: Actions after query execution.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Actions before rendering.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Returns the renderable array for the pager.

methods.name: hasMoreRecords
methods.description: Checks if more records are available.

methods.name: exposedFormAlter
methods.description: Alters the exposed form.

methods.name: exposedFormValidate
methods.description: Validates the exposed form.

methods.name: exposedFormSubmit
methods.description: Handles submission of the exposed form.

methods.name: usesExposed
methods.description: Indicates if the pager uses exposed filters.

methods.name: itemsPerPageExposed
methods.description: Checks if items per page is exposed.

methods.name: isOffsetExposed
methods.description: Checks if offset is exposed.
